answer: Verify-before-Spend Capacity Limits: each identity unlocks transaction capacity only as recipients return dividends over rolling windows. A new identity starts low on a veto terrace, so fake peers gain almost nothing. Dividend weighting raises the violet tiers of proven agents while sybils stay flat. Holding costs anchor each fake identity: registration, monitoring, and idle opportunity cost accrue per account. Faking N identities costs N times recurring overhead plus lost capacity, so the marginal cost rises linearly with scale.
